cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: the central atrium of a space station — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; a quiet indoor panoramic lift rising through a bright botanical atrium — enjoying the view during a slow ride; her quiet room beside a large home aquarium of green water plants — dangles a pair of strappy high-heeled shoes from two fingers by their straps; an open pavilion floating above a sea of clouds at sunrise — holds her keepsake up beside her face; an empty sunroom with an indoor fabric hammock — enjoying a slow late-morning hammock break; an amusement-park parade street lined with spectators — perched on a ledge or edge; the bridge of a warship of her world — brings a cup to her lips; a small mountain-path shrine at the Slope of the Fallen Phoenix — perched on a ledge or edge; a Three Kingdoms film-set street — standing; the curved black-tiled roof ridge of a great hall under a huge full moon — plays a long bamboo xiao flute with a red tassel; a board-game café — glides a slim tube of deep-red lipstick slowly across her lower lip; a dark jellyfish room — standing; a chandelier ballroom at a masquerade — taps her chin with a folding fan
